title: Black Clover Season 2 Just Gave Asta a Powerful New Sword
content: Black Clover has officially made its return to screens with Season 2 of the anime, and with it has kicked things off by giving Asta a powerful new sword. Black Clover has finally made its return after five long years with a brand new season of the anime , and it’s picking up right from where it all left off.
author: ComicBook

title: Digimon Reunites Its Classic DigiDestined With Epic Crossover – Watch Now
content: Digimon has kicked off a massive celebration for the franchise’s 30th anniversary, and with it has reunited most of its classic DigiDestined with a cool crossover to show them all off.
author: ComicBook

title: Manga 'Manshuu Ahen Squad' Gets Anime Adaptation
content: Publishing company Kodansha opened an official website for an anime adaptation of Tsukasa Monma and Shikako 's Manshuu Ahen Squad ( Manchuria Opium Squad ) manga on Monday. Monma and Shikako began serializing the historical crime manga on the Comic Days platform in April 2020.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Naruto Live-Action Movie Report Teases Big Changes & Fans Aren’t Happy
content: Rumors of a Naruto live-action movie have been swirling for years, with some fans saying it would be the best thing to happen to the series since it was released and others claiming it would be impossible to pull off while still doing justice to the 700+ episodes’ worth of story .
author: ComicBook

title: Manchuria Opium Squad Manga Gets Anime
content: This year's 45th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Monday that writer Tsukasa Monma and late artist Shikako 's Manchuria Opium Squad manga is receiving an anime adaptation. The manga also resumed serialization in the magazine on Monday, with new artist Tsurushima drawing the manga.
author: ANN

title: 'Charisma' Announces Additional Staff
content: The special livestream presentation for the television anime adaptation of the Charisma House mixed-media project revealed additional staff and a key visual (pictured) on Sunday. The anime series will premiere on TBS affiliate networks in January 2027.

title: Darkroom Streams Angel Densetsu Anime
content: The two-part OAV originally debuted in September 1996. Darkroom describes the OAV : Upon transferring to Hekikuu High School, Kitano soon discovers that his pale skin, sharp features, and awkward social skills make everyone assume he is a vicious delinquent or drug addict.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Film Streams 1st 4 Minutes
content: The staff for Seishun Buta Yarō wa Dear Friend no Yume o Minai ( Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend ) film, the latest anime of Hajime Kamoshida 's Rascal Does Not Dream (Seishun Buta Yarō or Aobuta) novel series, began streaming the film's first four minutes and posted a "finale visual" on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Zoids Franchise Announces New Zoids: Chaotic Century Manga
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Takara Tomy 's Zoids franchise announced on Friday that a new manga tentatively titled Zoids: Chaotic Century Kanketsu-hen (Zoids: Chaotic Century Final Chapter) is currently in the works. More details about the manga will be announced at a later date.
author: ANN
